references.rh_critical: Sundqvist, Berge & Kristjansson (1989), Mon. Wea. Rev. 117; initial values ACF choice (HYPOTHESIS), calibrated against IFS tcc by tools/awci/calibrate_cloud_rhc.py
references.sigma_bounds: ECMWF parameter database, low/medium/high cloud cover (params 186-188)
references.layer_min_fraction: 1 okta, smallest reportable amount (FEW): ICAO Annex 3 App. 3, WMO code table 2700
references.ceiling_max_base_m: ICAO Annex 2, definition of ceiling (below 6000 m / 20000 ft, more than half the sky)
references.glaciation_temp_k: -20 degC: glaciation of convective tops observed near -20 to -25 degC, Rosenfeld & Lensky (1998), BAMS 79
references.capillatus_temp_k: -38 degC: homogeneous freezing of supercooled droplets, Pruppacher & Klett (1997)
references.lenticularis_froude: mountain-wave regime Fr = U/(N h) of order 1, Durran (1990), Meteor. Monogr. 23; bounds ACF choice
references.condensate_min_kg_m2: convection is diagnosed only where the IFS column holds condensate (tcw - tcwv >= 10 g m-2): no model cloud, no convective cloud; ACF choice
references.other: ACF choices, status HYPOTHESIS, to be validated against METAR cloud groups (SP3)
references.convection_realised: TCU and Cb require an IFS precipitation rate >= 0.1 mm/h (tprate): the model's convection is realised, not only possible (CAPE, depth). Selected against METAR on calibration runs, judged on separate test runs (calibration_convection); rules on MUCAPE alone did not improve ETS. Status HYPOTHESIS

calibration_convection.method: tools/awci/calibrate_convection.py: best ETS with frequency bias in [0.7, 1.5] on calibration runs, among stricter rules (mucape, column condensate, precipitation rate)
calibration_convection.observations: METAR/SPECI, NOAA/NWS Aviation Weather Center (public domain), +-30 min, nearest grid cell
calibration_convection.event: TCU or CB observed (TS/VCTS included); AUTO reports without cloud type excluded
